navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; navbar__brand (warehouse app icon + 'StockFlow' title) on the left, navbar__link nav on the right; navbar__link--active carries the brand-red active state

page.notes: warm-oat page background, centered ~960px content column; page__header holds page__title with the warehouse app icon (page__title-icon) next to the name

card.notes: white surface on warm-oat, soft navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --radius-lg, --space-5 padding; stock table and detail panels live in cards

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0 corners, Receive/Pick/Save/active), btn--secondary (outlined), btn--ghost (text-only)
button.notes: tap targets >= 44x44px on the tablet UI; brand red reserved for the primary action only

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above the input (never placeholder-only); --radius-sm; focus ring via --color-info; field__error shows validation inline next to the field, naming it

table.notes: cool uppercase header row (--color-cool, --text-sm, uppercase); quantity cells (stock-table__num) right-aligned in --font-mono with tabular-nums so columns align; calm high-contrast rows for scanning

status_badge.notes: pill, --text-xs uppercase; ALL five stock states carry meaning by BOTH text label and color/shape, never color alone (out reads 'out' + error color, low reads 'low' + warning color)

empty_state.notes: line-style icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); a SKU with no batch/serial detail shows a clear 'not tracked'; never a blank region

toast.notes: fixed top-right; feedback never shifts page layout; error toast used for failed barcode scans (unknown/locked)

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input on the warehouse floor; a successful scan flashes green and the stock row updates in place, a failed scan flashes red and raises a persistent error toast

app_icon.notes: warehouse brand mark from .consort/design/assets/warehouse.png, installed to client/public/warehouse.png; rendered in the navbar next to 'StockFlow', in page__title-icon, and set as the browser-tab favicon in index.html
